description: Get the AI-Cited Lists state of a product: counters, setup requirements and onboarding. Read it first: data.setup.missing lists what outreach still needs (mailbox, sender_details, top_up_consent) and data.checked says whether ChatGPT was asked yet. On a product without the Backlinks Enterprise plan it returns AI_CITED_LISTS_ENTERPRISE_REQUIRED with details.upgrade_url for the human.
name: ai_cited_lists_status
title: Ai cited lists status
